title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.42141v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent work shows that a frozen robot policy performs far better inside an agent harness, where control code decides when to query the policy, consult vision tools, or command the arm directly. Yet today these harnesses are built by hand and redesigned for each new robot or benchmark. We show that harness design can be automated, offering a strong alternative to finetuning on a novel setup. In RoboArchitect, a coding model observes a robot's rollouts, diagnoses failures, and iteratively revises the harness around the frozen policy. The harness evolves on a set of episodes for its optimization and is evaluated on held-out scenes and tasks. Without updating any model weights, RoboArchitect raises average success from 9.7% to 43.3% on unseen scenes (4.5x) and from 12.7% to 40.2% on unseen tasks (3.2x), across multiple benchmarks and policies. The gains are largest where the benchmark is far from the policy's training data: wrapping a gene

translated_title: RoboArchitect：具有持久记忆的机器人智能体设计自动化
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，冻结的机器人策略若置于一个智能体框架（harness）之中，其表现会远好于单独使用——在该框架中，控制代码决定何时查询策略、何时调用视觉工具、或何时直接指挥机械臂。然而，目前这类框架均需人工构建，且每换一个新机器人或新基准就要重新设计。我们证明框架设计可以自动化，这为在新环境中微调模型提供了一种强有力的替代方案。在 RoboArchitect 中，一个代码生成模型观察机器人的运行轨迹，诊断失败原因，并围绕冻结策略迭代地修改框架。该框架在一组用于优化的任务片段上演化，并在留出的场景和任务上进行评估。在不更新任何模型权重的情况下，RoboArchitect 将未见场景上的平均成功率从 9.7% 提升至 43.3%（4.5 倍），将未见任务上的平均成功率从 12.7% 提升至 40.2%（3.2 倍），且该结果覆盖多个基准与策略。当基准任务与策略训练数据差距越大时，收益越为显著（原文此处截断）。
tldr: RoboArchitect 通过让代码生成模型观察机器人失败轨迹并自动迭代设计控制框架，在不更新任何模型权重的情况下，将冻结机器人策略在未见场景和任务上的成功率提升了 3.2 至 4.5 倍。
en_tdlr: RoboArchitect automates the design of control harnesses around frozen robot policies by having a coding model observe rollouts, diagnose failures, and iteratively revise code, raising success rates 3.2x–4.5x on unseen scenes and tasks without updating any model weights.
